en: Someone is watching... The feeling of eyes on your back is hard to shake.
text: Te privește cineva... E greu să scapi de senzația unor ochi ațintiți în spatele tău.

en: There's someone squeezed in under the desk!
An ordinary desk. Nobody under it this time.
A pair of eyes is peering out from between the leaves of the potted tree!
A potted tree. Its leaves are a little ruffled.
One of the dresser's drawers is breathing!
A dresser full of capes, false noses and very long scarves.
Someone outside is pressing their nose flat against the window!
A window. Route 110's grass sways outside.
The flowers in the planter are wearing a hat!
A planter of bright flowers.
The cupboard door creaks open by itself... and someone inside creaks it shut again!
A cupboard. Only cups inside.
The curtain behind the window has a pair of shoes under it!
A window with a long curtain.
The cushion on the floor is rather lumpy... and it just said "ouch"!
A flat, comfortable cushion.
Trick Master
Curses! Discovered! I am the Trick Master, master of disguise, deviser of devilish puzzles!
You found me fair and square, so I shall let you take on my house of tricks. Behind the scroll lies my puzzle!
Solve it and reach the end, and a reward awaits you. Now, watch closely... Vanish!
Foiled again! Nobody else in Hoenn ever finds me, you know. Nobody!
Very well. My newest puzzle waits behind the scroll, and it is more devious than the last!
Reach the end and a reward is yours. Now... Vanish!
A scroll hangs on the wall. It looks like there might be something behind it...
text: Pe perete atârnă un sul. Pare că ar putea fi ceva în spatele lui...

en: The scroll is rolled up. A way into the Trick Master's puzzle lies beyond it!
text: Sulul e strâns. Dincolo de el e drumul spre puzzle-ul Maestrului Trucurilor!

en: The scroll hangs down again. The Trick Master must still be building what's behind it.
text: Sulul atârnă din nou. Maestrul Trucurilor încă mai construiește ce e în spatele lui.

en: Trick Master
Ah, my challenger! Patience, patience. My next puzzle needs more time than a single night.
text: Ah, ai venit să mă provoci! Răbdare, răbdare. Următorul meu puzzle cere mai mult de o singură noapte.

en: Come back another day, a little stronger. I'll have something truly devious waiting for you!
text: Revino altă dată, cu o echipă puțin mai puternică. Te va aștepta ceva cu adevărat viclean!

en: Every puzzle I ever built, solved. Every one! I've run out of tricks...
...for now! A master of disguise always has one more up his sleeve. Some day!
Ah, the tent I owe you! Has your PC room for it now?
{player} sent the Red Tent to the decoration PC.
There! Pitch it somewhere I'd never think to hide.
Still no room! I'll keep it a while longer. Come back once there's space.
